Delete instance "{{instance}}"?
This removes the instance (under provider {{provider}}) and all its model configurations ({{count}}). Knowledge base retrieval using these models will fail and cannot be recovered.
embeddingModel.title: Configured Model Providers
embeddingModel.subtitle: Manage the model providers under the RAGFlow tenant
embeddingModel.emptyDescription: After adding a model provider and configuring its API Key, all embedding models of that vendor become selectable when creating a knowledge base in this scope.
embeddingModel.modelDisabled: Model disabled (hidden when creating a new knowledge base)
embeddingModel.deleteInstanceTitle: Delete instance (removes this API Key and all its models)
embeddingModel.clickToDisable: Click to disable (hidden when creating a new knowledge base)
embeddingModel.disableNote: Once disabled: the model is hidden when creating a new knowledge base; existing knowledge bases are unaffected.
embeddingModel.addDialogDescription: Configure the API Key of a model provider. Once added, all embedding models of that vendor become available automatically, no per-model selection needed. The API Key is bound to the RAGFlow tenant of the current scope.
embeddingModel.instanceNamePlaceholder: Name this API Key group for distinction (one vendor can have multiple instances)
embeddingModel.baseUrlPlaceholder: Custom API address, leave empty to use the default
embeddingModel.verifyNote: On submit the API Key is verified for connectivity first, and the instance is added once it passes. All embedding models of that vendor become available automatically and can be selected when creating a knowledge base; unneeded models can be disabled individually in the list.
